conjecture: The cyclic H^2 engine: for a finite cyclic group C_n = Z/n acting TRIVIALLY on Z, degree-2 group cohomology is computed by the norm map, H^2(C_n; Z) = Z^{C_n}/N.Z = Z/nZ, where N = 1 + g + ... + g^{n-1}. Under the trivial action g-1 acts as 0 and N acts as multiplication by n, so the standard 2-periodic free resolution of Z over Z[C_n], applied Hom(-, Z), collapses to the reduced cochain complex Z --0--> Z --(.n)--> Z --0--> Z --(.n)--> ..., whose degree-2 cohomology is ker(d2)/im(d1) = Z/nZ. This is the linear-algebra kernel that decides whether H^2_{Cat_B}(K_{2,3}) is nonzero once Ferri's (n,g,M) is in hand (the K_{2,3} live cases are n=2,3): H^2(C_2;Z)=Z/2, H^2(C_3;Z)=Z/3. FORMALISED sorry-free in Lean 4 core (Mathlib-free).

SCOPE/HONESTY: what is machine-checked is (i) the reduced cyclic cochain complex and the cochain-complex identities d_{i+1} o d_i = 0; (ii) Z^2 = ker d2 = all of Z (twoCocycle) and B^2 = im d1 = nZ (twoCoboundary_iff); (iii) H2 n := Z/im(d1) as an explicit Quotient with hand-built Add/Zero/Neg and the abelian-group laws proved (add_comm/add_assoc/zero_add/add_zero/neg_add_cancel), plus the identification mk a = mk b <-> n | (a-b) (H2.mk_eq_iff, H2.mk_eq_iff_dvd) and mk a = 0 <-> n | a (H2.mk_eq_zero_iff); (iv) the K_{2,3} corollaries as 'exactly n distinct classes covering Z' (H2_two_distinct + H2_two_cover; H2_three_distinct + H2_three_cover). NOT formalised (BLACK BOX, cited not re-proved): that this reduced 2-periodic complex COMPUTES group cohomology of C_n -- the periodicity/comparison-of-resolutions theorem (Cartan-Eilenberg; Brown, Cohomology of Groups, VI.9, Tate cohomology of cyclic groups). tree.approach: Cyclic H^2 via the norm map, H^2(C_n;Z)=Z/nZ for trivial action, formalised sorry-free in Lean 4 core. Engine for the H^2_{Cat_B}(K_{2,3}) decision.

children.approach: The reduced cyclic cochain complex (trivial Z-coeffs): d0=0, d1=.n (norm), d2=0, d3=.n; complex identities d_{i+1} o d_i = 0 (d1_comp_d0, d2_comp_d1, d3_comp_d2); Z^2 = all of Z (twoCocycle); B^2 = nZ (twoCoboundary_iff); H2 n := Quotient(cobSetoid n) with Add/Zero/Neg and abelian-group laws; mk a = mk b <-> n | (a-b) (H2.mk_eq_iff / H2.mk_eq_iff_dvd), mk a = 0 <-> n | a (H2.mk_eq_zero_iff). Sorry-free; axioms propext + Quot.sound.

K_{2,3} corollaries: H^2(C_2;Z)=Z/2 and H^2(C_3;Z)=Z/3, exhibited as 'exactly n pairwise-distinct classes covering Z' -- H2_two_distinct + H2_two_cover, H2_three_distinct + H2_three_cover. Machine-checked (constant modulus, omega). These are the concrete arithmetic inputs to the K_{2,3} loop-subgroup / separation nodes.

BLACK BOX (cited, not formalised): the standard 2-periodic free resolution of Z over Z[C_n] computes the group cohomology of C_n, so the cohomology of the reduced cochain complex above IS H^*(C_n;Z). Periodicity of cyclic-group cohomology / Tate cohomology.
